goalTarget.doc: What the goal names. ClaimLandmarks may name a landmark KIND (Watchtower) or nothing for any.

rewardPack.doc: A card pack handed over on the claim — the first is how the collection is met (Docs/features/22-progression.md §7).

autoClaim.doc: Claims itself the moment it is done — for a quest whose next step the player is already reaching for, where a tap on the scroll would only be in the way.

tutorialRentSeconds.doc: Tutorial pacing, for a quest that collects Gold: this many seconds after the quest becomes active, the first house's store is topped up with the Gold the goal still asks, instead of waiting on its rent. Null: the real rent.
